prompt: How many mountain peaks over 7,200 metres (23,622 feet) are there in Pakistan?
answer:
Pakistan has **31 mountain peaks above 7,200 metres (23,622 feet)**, based on the commonly cited list of its highest peaks.  

The figure can vary slightly depending on whether subsidiary summits and peaks in disputed border areas are included.
